Yes, in the latest run. The earlier run had a gap on the last day.

**Latest run (run-2, 12 Nov 2026):** All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) are marked covered for the whole period, 1–8 October 2026. Under the rule that every day must be covered by each sensor, the period counts as fully checked. No thermal detections intersected the asset (ASSET-F27).

**Earlier run (run-1, 8 Oct 2026):** Each sensor was covered only through 7 October. The final day, 7–8 October, was not covered because the near-real-time data had not yet been published, or the day was still in progress. That run also found no detections, but it was incomplete.

Run-2 supersedes run-1, so the "no detections" result now applies to the full period. Note that asset area is not reported (null), which doesn't affect the coverage conclusion.
